name: Distortion

description.content: When the trial starts, and after being chased for [15s], you earn [1] Token, up to [2].
While not downed, whenever the Killer attempts to see your Aura, spend [1] Token. Then, for the next [12s]:

items: The Killer cannot see your Aura.

quote: "Exploration of Norse mythology: bravery can conceal your flaws, even at your most vulnerable." -Jeff, pencil on toned paper
